label: Best in Class
corporate_parent: Sub-Zero Group, Inc. — privately held, Fitchburg/Madison, Wisconsin

burner_system.description: Two-tier burner design with independent gas feeds. Upper tier delivers up to 20,000 BTU for searing; lower tier provides 300-500 BTU precision simmer. Sealed design with seamless burner pans for easy cleaning.
burner_system.supplier: Proprietary Wolf casting — not Sabaf OEM. In-house design and manufacturing.

grate_system.description: Continuous heavy cast iron grates allow sliding cookware between burners. Pro-standard >20 lbs total weight.

construction.body: Welded stainless steel, pro-style commercial-derived construction

oven_convection.system_name: Dual VertiCross convection — twin vertical fans and dedicated heating elements for even multi-rack cooking
oven_convection.description: Eliminates hot/cold spots. Enables consistent results across all rack positions.

broiler.description: Intense focused heat mimicking commercial salamander broilers. Ideal for searing and caramelizing while retaining moisture.

performance_evidence.oven_temp_uniformity: ≤5°F delta — premium benchmark due to VertiCross dual fan system
performance_evidence.boil_time: good — sealed burners slightly slower than open (BlueStar) but competitive
performance_evidence.broiler_performance: Infrared — genuine searing differentiator vs gas standard broilers

yale_service_rate.notes: Wolf NOT in Yale gas range service data. However, installer consensus and Town Appliance rank Wolf as having lowest callbacks among pro-style ranges.

igniter_type.description: Industry-standard silicon nitride hot surface igniters — 2-3x longer lifespan than silicon carbide. Automatic re-ignition feature enhances safety.

warranty.limited_5yr_components: Gas burners, electric heating elements, electronic control boards
warranty.description: Full 2-year warranty (best standard in pro-style). Extended to 3 years with Factory Certified Installation. Limited 5-year warranty on key components.

service_network.description: Sub-Zero/Wolf Factory Certified Service network. Customer care: 1-800-222-7820. Online locator at subzero-wolf.com/locator.

parts_availability.description: Proprietary parts available through factory-certified network. Not universal fit.

control_board.notes: Electronic control boards covered under limited 5-year warranty — manufacturer confidence signal.

safety_evidence.recalls: None identified for current Wolf gas range models
safety_evidence.gas_emissions: NO₂ from gas combustion is non-differentiated by brand. Proper ventilation (hood rated ≥600 CFM) is the intervention.

platform_disclosure.cross_category_wall_oven: INVESTIGATION NEEDED: Wolf range oven section likely shares VertiCross convection, ERC controls, cavity, and heating elements with Wolf M Series wall oven. Deep dive did not confirm at part-number level. Both products manufactured in Fitchburg, WI.
platform_disclosure.cross_brand: None — Sub-Zero Group is single-brand (Wolf, Sub-Zero, Cove). No rebadging risk.

corrections.reason: Deep dive confirmed extended warranty with FCI. Config had 2yr which is correct as baseline.

S: Yale Appliance (absence noted — no Wolf gas data available)
